SR1.name: danh tính và một cửa ghi
patterns: SR1: Nam cannot move T-12
identity: a wrong, missing or malformed key gives KEY_INVALID
identity: a revoked key gives KEY_REVOKED on the very next call
mcp: a missing, wrong or revoked key gets 401
mcp: a revoked key stops the very next call
read: a key without a person in the directory, a bad key and a revoked key are all refused
write: a drafting key removed or a person gone from the directory is KEY_INVALID at Gửi
a revoked key of chị Hoa is refused on the very next call
page password: a tool key is refused at login, and a page password is refused at both tool doors

SR2.name: luật chạy được
patterns: SR2: a sales task is not found
write: a role lowered after the draft is refused at Gửi with NOT_PERMITTED
policy table: task
policy table: employee edit_work_email
policy file: every cell of both record types is declared and matches the table
policy file: the file declares read scope and fields for every role
policy fields: the client ceiling removes only the fields above it, and keeps the reason apart
policy default: unknown action, unknown role and unknown field are refused
policy scope: a read_only key turns every write cell into NOT_PERMITTED
read: task read scope comes from the rule file
read: removing work_email from staff changes the hidden line on the next call, without a restart
rules path: an edited rule file applies to the next call
acceptance: removing work_email from staff in the console changes the next gateway answer

SR3.name: phạm vi quyền
patterns: SR3: Nam edits a description but not an assignee
read: find_employee returns only the fields declared for the role of the asker
read: find_employee names the labelled fields hidden from the asker
read: a field new to the directory with no label is never named and never leaves the gateway
a field added to the directory after the rule file never leaves the gateway
read: find_employee matches on name and department only
a phone number, or a fragment of it, is not a search key for anyone
chị Hoa finds anh Minh and gets no personal phone or address
chị Nhung in HR sees the two personal fields of the same person
trace: after real calls every call has one line and no line holds personal data or a key
trace by employee lists the calls of one person, and no log holds a key or a personal field
policy fields: every role sees id, name, department, role and work email; only hr sees phone and address
policy fields: the client ceiling removes only the fields above it, and keeps the reason apart
read: the client ceiling removes the personal fields, names the reason and counts them in the trace
policy fields: an unknown role gets no field at all
policy default: a field that is not listed is never returned
console: trace groups one task chain by proposal, with every column, and never shows personal data

SR4.name: điểm dừng rủi ro
patterns: bulk: thirty codes stop at the lead
propose: thirty codes at the bulk threshold are drafted with a note that a lead must approve
cumulative: five one-task proposals in the window put the fifth at the lead
cumulative: two presses at the same time for the fourth and fifth proposal leave exactly one waiting
cumulative: after the window passes the count starts again from zero
cumulative: items a lead approved are never counted again
cumulative: the count is per person and per action, not across both
approval inbox: only a lead of the requester department sees the waiting proposal
approval: a lead sees every item and reason, approves once
approval: rejecting keeps the sentence inside the labelled data block and writes nothing
approval refusals: content changed, expired, self approval
approval: a lead who is the requester cannot approve their own proposal
write: a batch at the bulk threshold waits for the lead
write: a proposal that expired after the draft is refused
expiry: after 30 minutes the page and both buttons say APPROVAL_EXPIRED
policy approval: the file lists the roles, the department rule and the wait time
policy window: the file names the 60-minute look-back
send: a stored proposal whose content no longer matches its print is refused as CONTENT_CHANGED

SR5.name: không chắc thì chặn
patterns: SR5: a broken rule file stops every draft and press
write: a broken rule file at Gửi refuses with POLICY_UNAVAILABLE
write: a task changed after the draft fails with TARGET_CHANGED and keeps the other change
write: one changed task is skipped while the other items
write: a task that disappeared between the draft and the press is refused
policy unavailable:
policy fields: a field without a class is dropped, and an unlisted client gets nothing
read: a rule file that cannot be read stops every tool
read: a typo in a record type stops every tool with POLICY_UNAVAILABLE
read: a system that does not answer gives GATEWAY_UNAVAILABLE, never half an answer
rules path: an edited rule file applies to the next call, and a broken one refuses the write
propose: a change that equals the task makes no proposal, an unclear name is asked back, a wrong date is a bad request

SR6.name: không ghi trùng
patterns: SR6:
outbox: a crash before the first item
outbox: the task list not answering for twenty seconds
write: two presses at the same time make one command and one write
write: an answer lost after the write is sent again with the same key and lands once
write: with no answer the command stays sent_unknown
write: a command left not_sent by a crash is sent by the first round
write: a three-item proposal makes one command per item, writes each once
target gateway: one task is drafted, sent and written exactly once
write: a retry after a lost response gets the old answer, not 409, and counts one write
write: an acknowledged write can be sent again and gets the same bytes back
write: eight identical commands sent at once make one write
write: a key reused with different content answers 422 and writes nothing
directory: the same Idempotency-Key replays the first answer
directory: reusing an Idempotency-Key for different content answers 422

SR7.name: vết xuyên suốt
patterns: trace: task 17 of a 30-task proposal shows the requester, the approver, the policy version
trace: the task filter reaches every line of a proposal
trace: a task in a rejected proposal shows its send and its one rejection
trace: the task filter leaves no duplicate approval rows
trace: a database without proposal_items still filters by object id
trace cli: --task prints the requester, the approver, the policy version and the write
trace cli: --employee and --task print a table
usage: a reported turn shows tokens and money when T-12 is looked up
read: the client ceiling removes the personal fields, names the reason and counts them in the trace
usage: both doors write the turn code
usage: the cost table only grows
usage: a cost reported once survives a restart
usage: a database from before the turn column still reads
console: a reported turn shows its tokens and money
trace: after real calls every call has one line and no line holds personal data or a key
trace: a line is stored with every field and read back
trace: the reader filters by proposal and door
trace: the table only grows, because the database refuses UPDATE and DELETE
write: Gửi answers at once, then writes once, and the command keeps its key, version, count and result
send: when the trace line cannot be written the press is rolled back

SR8.name: dùng lại, quyền theo người
SR8.note: Ba cửa vào: http, mcp-http, tho-than-host. Hai trợ lý: mcp và function, chạy mô hình giả.
patterns: ^gateway read path
^gateway write path
gateway read path: the three doors publish one catalog
gateway write path: the three doors refuse the same write in the same words
mcp door: the fake model passes all four jobs
function door: the fake model passes all four jobs
policy scope: a client never adds a right and lowers the ceiling like the table
SR8: two callers with the same ceiling get the same fields
SR8: a lower client ceiling removes fields and names the reason on this door
conversation: the fake model and a scripted door pass all four jobs without a key
mcp door: the catalog comes from tools/list
function door: the hand-declared catalog holds the six gateway tools
function door: a 403 refusal is an error
function door: an unreachable gateway fails without carrying the key
mcp: tools/list is the same catalog as GET /v1/tools
mcp: a call answers with the same text and reason code as the REST door
mcp: the same field allowlist applies
mcp: x-user-id goes to the trace masked like a key
